snippet.title: AENIGMA - Official Gameplay Trailer [ Indie-Credible Showcase 2026 ] [4K]
snippet.description:
Set in the year 4XXX, humanity lives disconnected inside underground megastructures to escape the threat of the ever-expanding silicon-based lifeforms. After the nuclear fallout from the third war, the planet's surface was rendered uninhabitable. Silicon-based life were created to serve as slaves being tasked with building underground structures for shelter inside of the planet's mantle. When they grew in number, they slaughtered the carbons who claimed ownership over them.
